name: Skinner v3.3.4 — Final Catalog Cleanup, Targeted Removals & Duplicate Fixes
changelog: Final Skin Removals: Precision removal of 13 targeted skin records across 12 legends (Ezio Anakin, Petra Ken, Rayman Dhalsim, Jiro Yoshimitsu, Kor Four Arms, Koji CyberSam, Asuri Puss in Boots, Red Raptor Eren, Teros Roman Reigns & Gruagach, Ada Heatblast, Lord Vraxx Alien Warlord, Nash Becky Lynch).
Duplicate Stance Fixes: Pruned redundant stance duplicates for Priya (BladeDancer), Aurus (ActualGladiator), and Lady Vera (Cleric) while preserving canonical default costumes.
Nash Data Integrity: Verified complete roster for Nash (Gnash), removing Becky Lynch and Shovel Knight, while retaining all 15 distinct skins including all ZombieWalker variants.
Dual Installer Packaging: Distributes both Skinner-Setup-3.3.4.exe and Skinner-3.3.4-setup-x64.exe ensuring seamless automated updates across older clients.
Cryptographic Verification: All release binaries signed with official Ed25519 digital key and protected by SHA-256 manifests.
